audit_items.proof_trace: The middleware at src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts:51 blanket-exempts all /api/* routes from auth enforcement; API routes must self-protect. Three of four API routes call getUser() and return 401 on failure, but GET /api/auth/debug (marked temporary in its own header comment) has no authentication check at all and returns session state, Supabase auth cookie names, and forwarded host/proto headers to any caller.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An unauthenticated attacker sends GET /api/auth/debug; the middleware passes the request through (isPublicPath = true for /api), and the handler returns cookie metadata including Supabase token cookie names and x-forwarded-host/proto headers with no credentials required.
